name: orgsync
description: Use current company guidance, agree contributions and review evidence across AI apps, with attributable human confirmation.

hints_while_working.title: Hints while you work
hints_while_working.description: When your prompt, Claude's reply or a file it writes touches one of your company's decisions, add one short factual line naming it. Matching runs on this computer; nothing you type is sent to OrgSync.

capture_suggestions.title: Capture suggestions
capture_suggestions.description: Keep decisions from your sessions as private suggestions in your OrgSync queue. Runs only when your company and you turned capture on in OrgSync.

capture_model.title: Capture model
capture_model.description: The model on your own plan that finds those decisions; default uses this session's model.
